title: Unit Event — Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky — Episode3 An Idol's Electric Smile

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky
meta.Event Outline: Feeling the need for further practice leading up to their solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! decide to do a training camp that doubles as a streaming project. They start doing a variety of exercises under a special program devised by Airi, but something seems to be worrying Minori...

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
How's the ride, Haruka?!
Does it feel good?!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's great!
The water feels really nice as it sprays against my face!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka seems to be handling things okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-At this rate, this really is gonna end up being a test of how much idol power my heart can handle!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure our viewers can't wait to see what she has in store for us. Shall we give her the signal?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Haruka!
Get ready to show us your idol smile!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, here it goes.
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Haruka! Your smile made me asdfkyg@ljk>
<Completely stunned.>
<Please archive this video. I want to watch this part on repeat forever.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice smile, Haruka.
Worthy of a poster ad for a soda company I'd say.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm also seeing comments about it being on par with Shizuku's smile. What do you think, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?!
I-I'm sorry, my heart might've stopped just now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I knew that Haruka looked good wherever she went, but the sea takes the cake! The droplets of water from the ocean spray make it look like she's on a stage surrounded by blue glow sticks! It's so picturesque!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd love to enlarge it, put it in a big frame and hang it up on the biggest wall in my house so that I can greet her every day! Wait, then it'd be like we're living toge...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, calm down. I lost you towards the end there. Mind scoring Haruka's smile for us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course, Haruka gets the same score as Shizuku. 10 billion points!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know how you feel.
Her smile really was lovely.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Next, Minori, you're up.
I hope you're ready to also blow us away.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Am I really gonna be okay?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, Minori, it's finally your turn.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I doubt that I'll be able to match the two smiles that preceded me... But they gave me a big boost of energy, so I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. And we'll be cheering for you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you're such a hard worker, Minori, I have one piece of advice for you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Advice?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This actually isn't just about having a good idol smile.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, it isn't...?
What do you...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that's enough talk!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You seem plenty ready, Minori, so it's time for you to cast off!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Minori Hanasato's all set to go!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?!
I'm having trouble keeping my...
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Waaahhh!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you okay, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um...
I'm all wet now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-Why did I fall off just now?!
I thought I was keeping my balance okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After Shizuku and Haruka made it look so fun too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's actually pretty hard to stay aboard that thing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! Really?!
So, this activity's actually about...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe it's time to reveal the big secret now that you've all pretty much figured out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Singing and dancing are central to being an idol! And you need strong inner muscles to present yourself in an aesthetically pleasing manner... In other words, you need a really strong core!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why I decided to have us run a quick test to see where we all are individually in terms of core strength.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Now I get it...>
<So, Minori doesn't have a very good core?>
<Hang on. You don't really need a strong core just to ride a banana boat, right?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. This is no ordinary banana boat. It actually has some weights in it that cause the rider to fall right off unless they have the core to withstand the force.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't realize that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku, you did just fine. Why do you sound so surprised?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Because I couldn't tell at all...
I had no idea that it was designed to do what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is it possible that your core was naturally strengthened simply by working as a model...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I wonder...
Yes, I did quite a lot of core exercises to maintain a good posture...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's just Shizuku for you. She somehow always finds a way...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She's too amazing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Minori, you're gonna need to focus on strengthening your inner muscles.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As many core workouts as we've done during practices and such, you know that yours still needs work, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Guh...
I-I'll keep trying my best...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
As long as you diet and exercise properly, your core will naturally develop over time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just let me know if you ever want to hear some tips and tricks. For instance, your muscles tend to get broken down during workouts and you can mitigate that by taking essential amino acids.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I brought some powder that you mix with water for this training camp, so I'll be more than happy to share with you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Essential amino acids...? I've never heard of them before, but I'll drink lots and lots of that stuff if you recommend it, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: More isn't necessarily better in this case... But you're lucky to have such a good trainer by your side.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, Airi, you haven't ridden on the banana boat yet. You're not going to avoid riding it by pulling the producer card on us, are you...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course I'm riding it.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Really?!>
<We get to see Airi's amazing smile?!>
<Grace us with your power!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You got it!
I'm gonna show you all what a real idol smile is!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I can't wait to see that...!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I thought the water would be colder. It actually feels pretty nice!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Looks like Airi's doing just fine.
She hasn't budged at all...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
So, I'm the only one who had trouble riding it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's okay.
It just means we need to work on your core a little, which we can do during this training camp.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! I, Minori Hanasato, vow to do my best!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. And we'll be right behind you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, I believe it's about time we saw her idol smile. This is the camera, right...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sh-Shizuku, you're holding it upside down! I can handle it if you like!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, really..?
I really appreciate it, Minori. It's all yours.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I thought I was gonna have to do a handstand to watch.>
<It's so adorable how Shizuku and electronics don't get along...>
<You've got this, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks! Rookie videographer, Minori Hanasato, reporting for duty! Today, my goal will be to capture Airi's amazing smile! So, Airi, get ready!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone!
Are you ready to take a bunch of screenshots?!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Airi, you look absolutely adorable...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree! It's such a wonderful display of who you are...!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just getting started!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?
se_event_blue_2022_001
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, is that...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy Everyday's Happy Wipeout?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy Wipeout...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Whenever she fell into the pool during a variety show, she'd always make everybody laugh by striking a funny pose on her way down!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And she just did the one where the Little Mermaid's chasing after a crab! It's one of her most popular poses and we hardly ever get to see her do it!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line:
Whew!
Remember kids, don't try this at home!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I can't remember the last time I saw Happy Everyday's Little Mermaid pose!>
<As funny as it was, I'm starting to tear up from the nostalgia.>
<First time seeing it. I burst into tears laughing!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
A pose with a punchline.
We couldn't have asked for more, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, how was that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That was wonderful.
You had us laughing all the way through.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Cute and funny! You're really the best, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And your Little Mermaid pose at the end there was so good. It's a little sad compared to your initial idol smile, I guess? But I also thought it was just like you to add some drama to the mix.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It really was a sight to behold.
I doubt anyone besides you is capable of that, Airi, and I'm sure our viewers enjoyed what they just saw.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I love how Airi always finds ways to spice things up.>
<I knew you had something fun in store for us!>
<That was awesome! I'm glad you were on all those variety shows!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate all your comments. It was totally worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-Um, so... About that test...
I ended up being the only one who needs more training...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Would it be possible for me to try this again?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I probably won't be able to do anything like what Airi did... But I want to keep trying until I can pull off a proper idol smile!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's great to hear...!
And I like your moxie.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, we're not gonna cut any corners, so get ready to fully commit yourself to this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Understood!!
I, Minori Hanasato, promise to do my absolute best!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm exhausted!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You did work pretty hard during our special banana boat training session.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you managed to pull off a nice idol smile in the end, so I say, “Mission accomplished!” Plus, I think you got a better idea of how to engage your core and steady yourself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think you're right!
The area around my tummy feels kinda twitchy... Like it's gonna be super sore tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You did put in a great effort, Minori.>
<Your idol smile was really cute!>
<I can't believe you even learned how to do a Happy Wipeout!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Thank you all for your kind words! I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If I'm gonna be honest, you really didn't have to try doing my Happy Wipeout...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<The boat was fun, but so was watermelon smashing.>
<Yeah, I liked it when they smashed watermelons too.>
<That was an interesting game.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it was.
Especially how one of us was only allowed to help the blindfolded person by speaking, while the other was allowed to help them in any other way...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Things got really interesting when Minori was blindfolded. I couldn't talk, and when she made eye contact with Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh no! Minori's moving away from the watermelon! I have to help her!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Huh? What's with all these little holes?! They seem to be all over the place around here!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, Airi dug these to make it more difficult to walk. Unfortunately, I'm not allowed to talk, so I'll need Shizuku to tell Minori somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Shizuku, watch out...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Is Haruka trying to tell me something? What could she be...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, now I see! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Thank...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Minori!
Haruka says to watch out for the crabs that are walking around!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (N-No, not that...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't realize reaching the watermelon with a blindfold on would be so tough.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Fortunately, we managed to figure out a way to guide you to it in the end.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Haruka and I even worked out a system to communicate simply through eye contact.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, your teamwork was amazing!
Thanks to you two, we were able to have this really yummy watermelon!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that you all enjoyed it so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: About that, Airi. How did you come up with this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't conjure this up out of thin air.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A bunch of “blindfold games” exist out there that are all supposed to be good team-building exercises...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I thought it'd be fun to mix in watermelon smashing somehow since we'd be at the beach for our training camp.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! I didn't know that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I tried simulating it a few times, but wasn't really sure how it'd go for this. So, I'm really glad it went as well as it did...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our training camp also seems to be going very well overall.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's keep go, go, going!
What are we doing next?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't mean to be a buzzkill, but we'll be pausing the stream temporarily to take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<What? You're pausing the stream? But...>
<Yeah, you've been at it for a while now.>
<I agree. All of you deserve to take a break.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks. I get that parting is such sweet sorrow. However, if you want to put on a good performance, you have to train hard while making sure to recharge along the way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we'll be back in about two hours! Stay tuned, everyone! See you then...

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whew...
Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That was super fun!
But I ended up making so many mistakes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's totally fine since we got some really nice footage along the way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is turning out to be a really nice stream. We've been getting plenty of comments too, so let's make the most of this break and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Great stream, girls!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wah, Miku?!
Wait, you're all here?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hehe♪
We were watching your training camp stream in secret!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Are your viewers enjoying everything?
Also, would it be possible to see their comments?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why don't we take this opportunity to recap everything that's happened?

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
